title: Nonzero values on the support
statement: For a finite set $\Omega$, a probability mass function $p$ on $\Omega$, and a function $X : \Omega \to \mathbb{R}$, say that $X$ is nonzero at some point in the support of $p$ if there is an $x \in \Omega$ with $p(x) \ne 0$ and $X(x) \ne 0$.
